Disclaimer: This is a generic job description for the position stated below. Actual tasks and tools will be discussed further when you reach the final interview stage. Please ensure you apply for the right job based on your location and experience. We prioritize people who can do this successfully! Medical Scribe - Full Time Wing is on the exciting mission of redefining the future of work for companies worldwide! We are looking to be the one-stop shop for companies that are looking to build world-class teams & place their operations on autopilot. And we’re looking for a Medical Scribe - Full Time to start immediately Medical Scribe - Full Time Client Industry: Neurology Patient Insurance Client Location: Remote Assistant Schedule: 8:00AM-5:00PM (PST) Company Description: We are a leading neurology practice dedicated to providing exceptional care for patients withneurological conditions. Renowned for our commitment to patient-centered innovation andcollaboration, we are seeking a meticulous and patient-focused Insurance Verification Specialistto support our team. Job Summary: The Neurology Patient Insurance Verification Specialist will primarily be responsible for confirming the accuracy of patient insurance information, verification of benefits, interpreting benefits in terms of the practice's neurology services (such as EMG/NCV, EEGs, Office BasedE/M Codes), and ensuring all necessary documentation is collected for billing. This role is criticalin our commitment to providing seamless neurology care and minimizing delays in treatment. Responsibilities: 1. Verify insurance eligibility and benefits for all patients prior to their appointments. 2. Proficient in reading, analyzing, and interpreting CPT codes, authorization requirements, and related payer information to assess eligibility, secure approvals (including prior authorizations for neurology-specific procedures), and prevent claim denials. 3. Enter, update, and maintain accurate patient and insurance details in the practice management system. 4. Communicate with patients to clarify discrepancies in the insurance information and to explain their insurance coverage as it pertains to our neurology services. 5. Collaborate with the billing department to address any issues that may affect the billing process. 6. Work closely with insurance providers to resolve issues and gather information. 7. Assist patients with questions regarding their insurance coverage and out-of-pocket costs. 8. Maintain compliance with HIPAA and other federal/state regulations related to patient information and privacy. 9. Enter patient information into both Phreesia and Allscripts EHR. 10. Miscellaneous billing tasks as assigned. Qualifications: 1. At least 1 year of experience in healthcare insurance verification, medical billing, or arelated role; experience in a neurology or specialty practice preferred. 2. Familiarity with medical terminology, CPT, and ICD-10 codes, including those specific toneurology (e.g., for diagnostic testing and procedures). 3. Proficiency with practice management software and electronic health records (EHR). Wecurrently use Allscripts (Veradigm) EMR system. 4. Strong knowledge of insurance processes, including understanding of different types ofinsurance plans (PPO, HMO, EPO, Medicaid/Medicare, etc.) and medical billing practices,with an emphasis on specialty care requirements. Technical Requirements: • USB Headset with Noise Cancellation feature • Working Webcam • Computer with at least 1.8 GHz processor and at least 4GB RAM • Main Internet Service Speed: at least 25 Mbps cable connection • Backup Internet Service Speed: at least 10 Mbps Benefits: • Health Insurance (HMO) • Performance Incentives • Job Security and Stability • Paid Training • Inclusive Culture • Upskilling Opportunities • 100% Work-From-Home • Exceptionally Supportive Team • Opportunities

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:f6c9a50f-738.description: Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses, and our growth depends on a steady flow of qualified sales opportunities. We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to be the tip of that spear: the first person prospective customers meet and the engine that keeps our pipeline full. This is a high-energy, high-ownership seat for someone early in their sales career who wants to learn the craft fast and grow into bigger things. You'll identify companies that are actively hiring for roles Wing can support, reach out with a compelling alternative to traditional hiring, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. It's a great fit for someone who's competitive, well-organized, motivated by clear targets, and genuinely curious about how AI, remote talent, and global workforce solutions are changing the way companies build teams. Generate and Qualify Pipeline Identify companies actively hiring for roles Wing can service, such as Executive Assistants, Admin Assistants, Customer Support, Sales Support, Recruiting Support, Operations Support, and other business support roles. Research target accounts to understand what they are hiring for, why they may need support, and where Wing could be a strong fit. Reach out to prospective customers across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels. Run focused outbound campaigns around hiring signals, job postings, company growth, and operational pain points. Hold early discovery conversations to understand the prospect's hiring needs, pain points, urgency, and openness to remote talent or AI-enabled workforce solutions. Communicate what Wing Assistant does and why it matters clearly enough to earn the next meeting. Book qualified appointments for Account Executives with companies that have a clear need, relevant hiring activity, or a strong use case for Wing. Partner with the Sales Team Work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to build and protect a healthy, well-qualified pipeline. Hand off opportunities cleanly, with the context AEs need to move deals forward. Share key details from discovery calls, including the role the company is hiring for, current hiring process, pain points, timing, budget signals, and decision-makers involved. Keep activity, notes, and pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM. Bring the Market Back In Feed what you're hearing from prospects back to the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams. Help refine messaging and outreach based on what's actually landing with companies. Identify patterns in hiring demand, objections, and industries where Wing is resonating. Suggest new outbound angles based on job postings, hiring trends, and prospect conversations. Core Requirements 1–4+ years in sales, business development, appointment setting, cold calling, recruiting, staffing, or a comparable outbound role. A real interest in B2B sales; bonus points if it's in SaaS, AI, staffing, recruiting, outsourcing, or global workforce operations. Proven background in sales prospecting, cold calling, appointment setting, or high-volume outbound outreach. Strong written and verbal communication; you can get to the point and make it compelling. Comfort reaching out to companies that may not have considered remote assistants, virtual assistants, or offshore talent before. Strong research skills and the ability to turn hiring signals into relevant outbound messaging. Strong organization and the resilience to keep going when a day doesn't go your way. The drive that comes from chasing clear goals, activity metrics, and booked meeting targets. The ability to run your own desk while still collaborating well across teams. A genuine eagerness to learn the product, the industry, and the sales craft quickly. Nice to Have Exposure to staffing companies, recruiting firms, BPOs, outsourcing companies, virtual assistant companies, digital agent companies, or high-ticket professional services organizations. jobgether-jobgether:lever:449111de-285a-.title: Director of Marketing
jobgether-jobgether:lever:449111de-285a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in Greece. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led business.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e70abe60-069a-.title: Product Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e70abe60-069a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager based in Canada. This is a high-ownership product leadership role focused on completing a major transition from a legacy on-premise platform to a modern cloud-based solution. You will have direct responsibility for deciding product scope, prioritization, and customer migration readiness. Working closely with engineering, customer success, sales, support, and leadership, you will turn real customer needs into clear product decisions and measurable outcomes. The role requires someone who is comfortable making difficult trade-offs, defending priorities, and creating clarity in a fast-moving environment. You will spend meaningful time understanding customers in their real-world environments and translating those insights into product improvements. You will also help shape the platform’s longer-term innovation strategy, including practical adoption of AI across the product lifecycle. Own product scope and parity decisions, determining what capabilities must be available before customers migrate to the cloud and what can be delivered later. Build, own, and communicate the product roadmap while maintaining clear priorities amid competing stakeholder demands and changing timelines. Conduct hands-on customer discovery by observing users in their working environments and translating customer workflows, pain points, and feedback into actionable product decisions. Translate customer and business needs into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and downstream context for engineering, QA, support, training, and other teams. Define measurable outcomes for product initiatives, evaluate performance after launch, and take corrective action when products or features do not meet expectations. Lead cross-functional collaboration with engineering, sales, marketing, customer success, support, and leadership to align on priorities, delivery plans, and product launches. Help internal teams confidently represent and support the product by sharing product knowledge, context, priorities, and upcoming changes. Identify opportunities for innovation by monitoring customer needs, market developments, industry trends, and competitive dynamics. Explore practical applications of AI throughout the product lifecycle and help determine where AI-enabled capabilities can deliver meaningful value to customers. Use modern product and AI tools to improve research, analysis, prototyping, and day-to-day product management efficiency. Requirements: 5+ years of product management experience with a demonstrated record of owning products end to end, including strategy, prioritization, delivery, and outcomes. Proven experience making difficult prioritization and scope decisions and confidently defending those decisions with senior stakeholders. Direct experience with legacy modernization or platform migration, ideally involving an on-premise-to-cloud transition and customer-impacting parity decisions. Strong customer discovery skills, with the ability to engage directly with users, understand real-world workflows, and turn observations into product decisions. Excellent ability to create clear, detailed user stories that anticipate the needs of engineering, QA, support, training, and other downstream stakeholders. Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving, and lightly structured environments where you are expected to create clarity and drive progress. Strong judgment, accountability, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to navigate disagreement and high-pressure situations. Genuine curiosity about AI and willingness to use AI tools hands-on to improve your own workflow and explore potential product applications. Experience in automotive repair software or a related vertical industry is an advantage. Familiarity with product and project management tools such as Jira or Aha!, as

msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The Infrastructure Security Engineer designs, configures, and evolves Security Engineering services and platforms, building the technical capabilities and automation that enable the organization to efficiently implement the controls, governance, and protection needed to keep its assets secure. This is a hands-on, technically deep role for someone deeply curious about how systems break, understanding vulnerabilities from how they arise to how they're exploited and remediated, reaching for the right tool across a broad security toolset, and comfortable with red-team engagements and pentesting to validate weaknesses and demonstrate real-world risk. This role requires at least a working knowledge of one programming language and automation fundamentals, a strong foundation in network security, networking fundamentals, and core infrastructure including PKI and certificate management, web application mechanics, and client-server relationships, alongside hands-on experience maintaining Palo Alto firewalls. What will you do? Manage Palo Alto Networks firewalls, tuning configuration for security policies, threat prevention and application control. Participate in secure network architecture discussions in multi vendor environments, enforcing proper segmentation, zero trust and defense in depth strategies. Partner with network teams to implement security controls across LAN and WAN environments without compromising network performance. Own the technology implementation and delivery approach end to end, documentation, knowledge base upkeep and post implementation support. Secure hybrid and multi cloud environments, applying security controls for cloud networking services[ i.e. AWS & GCP VPC, load balancing, routing & cloud firewalls. Acts as the L3 escalation point for Security Operations issues and security incidents, taking on operational responsibilities as the need arises. Execute technical audits and compliance reviews, engaging constructively with our GRC function. Curate and evolve our security services and product catalog, ensuring each service is clearly defined, has service levels set and is marketed to key stakeholders, informed by findings surfaced during pentesting and red team engagements. Participate in business cases and storyboards that justify spend and technical decisions, including investments in Security Engineering applications built in house, working closely with the operations team to stay aligned on direction. Assist with the development of in house security tooling and automation that operationalizes internal and external pentesting workflows, turning offensive findings into repeatable, validated controls. Take on the technical development of recovery and business continuity plans, ensuring the security infrastructure survives system shocks and internal, or external events and validating resilience through offensive testing. Collaborate with Information Security & Information Technology leaders to define the year to year Network Security program roadmap, inclusive of our security platforms and in house engineered applications. Drive hyper automation into all security products and services, so minimal human engagement is need
